Resolves #18532

🌿 A parked vessel that re-shows one chrome off can no longer do so quietly: the OS frame and the manager's frame are now read back against the frame the park took, three cycles deep, on real chrome.

One e2e arm added to `WorkstationNativePopupOverPopupNL.spec.mjs`, riding the spec's existing popup-over-popup rig: the source vessel is moved by its OS titlebar onto the target (the only path that parks — the ticket's premise correction), the coordinator's candidate is cleared inside a widened handoff so the host refuses and re-shows, and the restored **outer** frame (OS `screenX/Y` + `outerWidth/Height`, and `manager.Window`'s `outerRect`) must equal the frame the park took it from, within 2 px, for three cycles. Chrome is derived from the real window (`outer − inner`), the cycle's park is identified by its cleared restore receipt rather than a host counter, and a vessel that closes mid-poll reads as "no frame" so the footprint assertion fails on its own message. The arm surfaced #19372 on the way; that repair merged as #19374.

Evidence: L3 (local real-chrome NL run, Brain-gated set, `viewport: null`: 4/4 at a7d00f00eb; two mutations red on the footprint line) → L3 required (AC-1–AC-4). AC-5 is unit-covered (`DockNativeVesselTransaction.spec.mjs:208`, "no chrome published ⇒ content origin is the frame origin"); a chrome-less window cannot be produced on this platform, and the arm skips with that reason when `outer == inner`. No residual.

agent-preflight: not run; this consumer's baseline jobs run in CI. The Brain-gated NL e2e set is excluded from CI (`NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` unset there), so the receipt below is the evidence.

| AC-4 | Outside-CI: `toFrameOrigin` → `{x: rect.x, y: rect.y}` (the #18515 revert) fails "cycle 1: the source re-shows at the outer footprint it was parked from, and stays open" with `restore.frame.y = 190` vs `parkedFrom.y = 123` (one chrome LOW). Second mutation, `resolveVesselRestoreAnchor` reading the OUTER rect (the #19372 regression): same line, `frame.y = 56` (one chrome HIGH). Clean run 4/4 after each revert. |
| AC-5 | CI-covered: `DockNativeVesselTransaction.spec.mjs:208`; the e2e arm skips on chrome 0 with the reason in its message. |

## Deltas from ticket
- The "related invariant" (tear-out outer size == tab body) is not asserted here: the rig resizes both vessels right after the pop-out and the helper returns no body rect, so it is filed as #19375, blocked by this ticket.
- The closed-page guard in `readFrame`: under the #18515 mutation the mis-placed re-show re-enters the target's drop zone and the handoff commits, which retires the vessel mid-poll; without the guard the arm died on `page.evaluate` against a closed page instead of naming the footprint.
